The server determines the real client IP in the `ClientIP()` method by first checking if the remote address is a trusted proxy, then iterating through configured headers (X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP by default) in order.

`gin.go`
The `validateHeader()` method parses the X-Forwarded-For header by checking IPs in reverse order, stopping at the first untrusted proxy to find the real client IP, while `isTrustedProxy()` validates if an IP falls within configured CIDR ranges using `SetTrustedProxies()`.

`context.go`
This file implements the `ClientIP()` method that determines the real caller address by checking TrustedPlatform, then RemoteIPHeaders when behind a trusted proxy, returning the innermost untrusted IP from comma-separated forwarded headers.

This file defines the Engine struct fields (`TrustedPlatform`, `RemoteIPHeaders`, `ForwardedByClientIP`) and implements `SetTrustedProxies()`, `isTrustedProxy()`, and `validateHeader()` which parse CIDR blocks and X-Forwarded-For headers to determine which proxies and forwarded headers to trust.
